_note: THE PILOT'S WHEEL RULE, WRITTEN ONTO THE CARDS FORGE PLAYS (2026-10-21). captain's log 002: 'those should be finisher kind of things ... Shabraz and Brallin are already out, they're kind of big, and I'm gonna drop a wheel on them'. The goldfish reads the same sentence from pilot_policy.json (rule wheel-is-a-finisher); Forge reads it here, as a NeedsToPlay hold on each wheel — the engine's cast gate honours it for any spell or ability (ComputerUtilCard.checkNeedsToPlayReqs, 2.0.14) and DiscardAi then fires the wheel in the first Main 2 it can afford. A hold is one-directional: it stops a cast, it does not cause one.
